text: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会印发《国家信息化“十五五”规划》。其中提出，完善一体化应用基础设施。实施国家区块链网络建设工程，夯实价值互联网基础。加快构建全国一体化算力网，推动算力、电力、网络协同发展。优化通用算力、智能算力、超级算力布局。探索太空算力前瞻研究和技术布局。稳妥建设数据流通利用基础设施。打造新型工业网络，推动移动物联网自主迭代。建设新型广电网络。推进交通、能源、市政、水利等基础设施数智化升级。
text_en: The Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued the National Informatization 15th Five-Year Plan. It proposes improving integrated application infrastructure. Implement the national blockchain network construction project and consolidate the foundation of the Internet of Value. Accelerate the building of a nationally integrated computing network and promote the coordinated development of computing power, electricity and networks. Optimize the layout of general computing power, intelligent computing power and supercomputing power. Explore forward-looking research and technological layout for space computing power. Steadily build infrastructure for data circulation and utilization. Build new industrial networks and promote independent iteration of the mobile Internet of Things. Build a new type of broadcasting network. Advance the digital and intelligent upgrading of infrastructure in transportation, energy, municipal services, water conservancy and other areas.
